claim_one_line: THE FRAMING LEDGER (the owner's exercise, 2026-11-03; OPEN, an audit): eighteen framing commitments inventoried from five readers (docs/FRAMING_LEDGER.md), then the question itself and its recognition audited (S291, § G: a blind sixth reader verified citation by citation, and main's control R1). Computed data-free (two coarse facts disclosed): the CKM's corner inversion is a construction choice -- the mirror rule cannot lift it, a same-sign singlet Higgs does nothing, an opposite-sign singlet (exactly the ADJUGATE reading adj(S) = eps S^T eps^T) balances the corners at all ten non-null phases (33-47% against 2%; median |V_ub|/|V_td| about 0.9, not nature's 0.43); on all 24 order-5 lines the frame is minimal SU(5) (Y_u symmetric, Y_e = lam Y_d^T with lam^5 = 1) and the leptons read the down sector through the adjugate, Y_e(S) = -lam Y_d(adj S)^T; c = 3 is the Georgi-Jarlskog factor by hand; the 45-like singlet does NOT give Georgi-Jarlskog's pattern (S290's claim retracted: mislabelled). Recognition: a theory exact at 2e16 GeV scores chi2_ten 11.8 at M_Z and pays 8.5 bits on K (one loop; B1825's address leaves 3.6); the headline counts a tier the record retired, and no outcome of any current test can move it. Six of the 19 have no frame; three are unexamined outputs. Claims no parameter. 0 of 19.
